en.headline: Lee tells scouts Hong Kong offers unlimited opportunities under One Country Two Systems
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee, as Chief Scout, outlined four expectations for young people at the Hong Kong Scout Association rally on Sunday.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Sunday that nurturing young people was the foundation for Hong Kong's long-term stability, international competitiveness and talent pool, while speaking as Chief Scout at the Hong Kong Scout Association rally.

Lee outlined four expectations: to have the nation in their hearts, to think globally, to strengthen their will, and to help others. He said the first five-year plan would continue to support young people in pursuing their dreams under the Youth Development Blueprint, aiming for a new generation that is patriotic, globally minded, ambitious and positive.

He emphasised that under One Country Two Systems, Hong Kong connects the Mainland and the world with unlimited opportunities, and that young people who dare to dream can fully develop their strengths. Lee also noted that the government is broadening channels for young people through Mainland exchanges, internships and entrepreneurship support, while encouraging international participation.

The rally took place at Hong Kong Stadium, where Lee witnessed the Scout Promise and presented certificates. He urged young people to face future challenges and rapid technological change with courage and to serve the community.

zh.headline: 李家超以童軍總領袖身分籲青年把握一國兩制機遇
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超周日出席香港童軍大會操，提出胸懷家國、放眼世界、錘鍊意志及助人為樂四點期望。
body: 行政長官李家超周日以香港童軍總領袖身分出席香港童軍總會大會操時表示，培育青年茁壯成長是香港長遠穩定發展、增加國際競爭力及構建人才庫的根基。
李家超提出四點期望，包括胸懷家國、放眼世界、錘鍊意志及助人為樂。他指首個五年規劃會繼續以青年發展藍圖為基礎，支持青年逐夢前行，成為愛國愛港、具備世界視野、有抱負及具正向思維的新一代。
他強調在一國兩制下，香港內聯外通，機遇無限，青年只要敢於築夢定能大展所長。李家超表示政府正為青年拓寬渠道，提供內地交流、實習及創業支援，並鼓勵參與國際交流平台。
大會操在香港大球場舉行，李家超見證童軍覆誓並頒發證書。他寄語青年迎難而上，主動服務社會。
